delete.title: Delete {{type}}?
delete.description:
Are you sure you want to permanently delete {{name}}?
This action cannot be undone.

selection.deleteDescription_one:
Are you sure you want to permanently delete the selected item?

This action cannot be undone.
selection.deleteDescription_other:
Are you sure you want to permanently delete the selected {{count}} items?

This action cannot be undone.

merge.hintSelectTwo: Select at least two to merge
merge.hintSessionSlow: These were recorded with different video or audio settings. Merging them would mean re-encoding, which takes too long for full sessions.
merge.hintClipSlow: These were recorded with different video settings, so they get re-encoded with your clip settings.

session.title: No sessions yet
session.bufferBody: Your capture mode is Replay Buffer, so games are not saved as full sessions. Moments you save show up under Replay Buffer.
session.autoRecordBody: Start a game and Segra records it in the background. The whole session shows up here when you close the game.
session.manualRecordBody: Auto-record is off, so a game is only recorded when you start the recording yourself.
session.pressHotkey: Press <kbd>{{keys}}</kbd> to start or stop a recording.

buffer.title: No replay buffers yet
buffer.offBody: The replay buffer is off. Switch your capture mode to Replay Buffer or Hybrid to save the last moments of a game with a hotkey.
buffer.keepLast: While you play, Segra keeps the last <nowrap>{{duration}}</nowrap> in memory. Press <kbd>{{keys}}</kbd> to save it here.
buffer.keepLastNoHotkey: While you play, Segra keeps the last <nowrap>{{duration}}</nowrap> in memory. Turn on the Save Replay Buffer hotkey to save it here.

clip.title: No clips yet
clip.body: Open a recording, press Add Segment to mark the moment you want, then press Create Clip.

highlight.offBody: Turn them on to join the kills and goals from a match into one video.
highlight.title: No highlights yet
highlight.autoBody: In supported games, Segra bookmarks your kills and goals and joins them into one video when the recording ends. You can also choose Create Highlight in a session's menu.
highlight.manualBody: Choose Create Highlight in a session's menu to join its kills and goals into one video.
